nodes.summary: Let $\alpha$ be a finite set with a $\sigma$-algebra in which singletons are measurable, let $p$ be a probability mass function on $\alpha$, and write $\mathbb{E}_p[h]$ for the expectation of $h : \alpha \to \mathbb{R}$ under $p$. For all $f, g : \alpha \to \mathbb{R}$, $\mathbb{E}_p[f + g] = \mathbb{E}_p[f] + \mathbb{E}_p[g]$.
nodes.title: Additivity of expectation on a finite type

nodes.summary: Let $\alpha$ be a finite set with a $\sigma$-algebra in which singletons are measurable, let $p$ be a probability mass function on $\alpha$, and write $\mathbb{E}_p[h]$ for the expectation of $h : \alpha \to \mathbb{R}$ under $p$. For every $c \in \mathbb{R}$ and $f : \alpha \to \mathbb{R}$, the function $a \mapsto c\,f(a)$ has expectation $c\,\mathbb{E}_p[f]$.
nodes.title: Homogeneity of expectation on a finite type

nodes.summary: Let $\alpha$ be a finite set with a $\sigma$-algebra in which singletons are measurable and let $p$ be a probability mass function on $\alpha$. For every $c \in \mathbb{R}$, the expectation of the constant function $a \mapsto c$ under $p$ is $c$.
nodes.title: Expectation of a constant on a finite type

nodes.summary: Let $p$ be a probability mass function on a set $\alpha$, and write $\overline{\mathbb{E}}_p[h]$ for the extended expectation of $h : \alpha \to [0, \infty]$ under $p$. For all $f, g : \alpha \to [0, \infty]$, $\overline{\mathbb{E}}_p[f + g] = \overline{\mathbb{E}}_p[f] + \overline{\mathbb{E}}_p[g]$.
nodes.title: Additivity of extended expectation

nodes.summary: Let $p$ be a probability mass function on a set $\alpha$. For every $c \in [0, \infty]$, the extended expectation of the constant function $a \mapsto c$ under $p$ is $c$.
nodes.title: Extended expectation of a constant

nodes.summary: Let $p$ be a probability mass function on a set $\alpha$, and let $s \subseteq \alpha$ be a finite set with $p(a) = 0$ for every $a \notin s$. For every $f : \alpha \to [0, \infty]$, the extended expectation of $f$ under $p$ equals $\sum_{a \in s} p(a)\, f(a)$.
nodes.title: Extended expectation under a finitely supported distribution

nodes.summary: Let $p$ be a probability mass function on a finite set $\alpha$. For every $f : \alpha \to [0, \infty]$, the extended expectation of $f$ under $p$ equals the finite sum $\sum_{a \in \alpha} p(a)\, f(a)$.
nodes.title: Extended expectation on a finite set

nodes.summary: Let $p$ be a probability mass function on a set $\alpha$, let $g : \alpha \to \beta$ be a map to a set $\beta$, and let $g_* p$ be the pushforward of $p$ along $g$, the probability mass function $b \mapsto \sum_{a : g(a) = b} p(a)$. For every $f : \beta \to [0, \infty]$, the extended expectation of $f$ under $g_* p$ equals the extended expectation of $f \circ g$ under $p$.
nodes.title: Change of variables for extended expectation

nodes.summary: Let $\alpha$ be a finite set with a $\sigma$-algebra in which singletons are measurable, let $p$ be a probability mass function on $\alpha$, and let $g : \alpha \to \mathbb{N}$. Let $x \in [0, \infty]$ be the extended expectation of $g$, viewed as a function to $[0, \infty]$, under $p$, and send $x$ to $\mathbb{R}$ by the map that is the identity on $[0, \infty)$ and sends $\infty$ to $0$. The result is the…
nodes.title: Extended and real expectations agree on natural-valued functions

nodes.summary: Let $p$ be a probability mass function on a set $\alpha$, and write $\overline{\mathbb{E}}_p[h]$ for the extended expectation of $h : \alpha \to [0, \infty]$ under $p$. For every index set $\iota$, finite subset $s \subseteq \iota$ and family of functions $f_i : \alpha \to [0, \infty]$ ($i \in \iota$), $\overline{\mathbb{E}}_p\bigl[a \mapsto \sum_{i \in s} f_i(a)\bigr] = \sum_{i \in s} \overline{\mathbb{E}}_p[f_i]$.
nodes.title: Extended expectation of a finite sum

nodes.summary: Let $\alpha$ be a nonempty finite type and $f : \alpha \to [0, \infty]$. The extended expectation of $f$ under the uniform distribution on $\alpha$ equals $|\alpha|^{-1} \sum_{a \in \alpha} f(a)$, computed in $[0, \infty]$.
nodes.title: Extended expectation under the uniform distribution

nodes.summary: For a probability mass function $p$ on a type $\alpha$ and a function $f : \alpha \to [0, \infty]$, the extended expectation of $f$ under $p$ is the unordered sum $\sum_{a \in \alpha} p(a) f(a)$ in $[0, \infty]$, which always exists.
nodes.title: Extended expectation

nodes.summary: Let $p$ be a probability mass function on a measurable space $\alpha$ in which singletons are measurable, and let $s$ be a finite subset of $\alpha$ such that $p(a) = 0$ for every $a \notin s$. Then for every function $f : \alpha \to \mathbb{R}$, the expectation of $f$ under $p$ equals $\sum_{a \in s} p(a) f(a)$.
nodes.title: Expectation of a finitely supported distribution

nodes.summary: Let $p$ be a probability mass function on a finite measurable space $\alpha$ in which singletons are measurable, and let $f : \alpha \to \mathbb{R}$. Then the expectation of $f$ under $p$ equals the finite sum $\sum_{a \in \alpha} p(a) f(a)$.
nodes.title: Expectation on a finite type

nodes.summary: Let $p$ be a probability mass function on a measurable space $\alpha$ in which singletons are measurable, and let $f : \alpha \to \mathbb{R}$ be integrable with respect to the probability measure associated to $p$. Then the expectation of $f$ under $p$ equals the unordered sum $\sum_{a \in \alpha} p(a) f(a)$.
nodes.title: Expectation as a series

nodes.summary: Let $p$ be a probability mass function on a finite measurable space $\alpha$ in which singletons are measurable, and let $q$ be a property of elements of $\alpha$. The expectation under $p$ of the function equal to $1$ where $q$ holds and $0$ elsewhere is $\sum_{a \in \alpha,\ q(a)} p(a)$, the total mass of the elements satisfying $q$.
nodes.title: Expectation of an indicator

nodes.summary: Let $p$ be a probability mass function on a finite measurable space $\alpha$ in which singletons are measurable, and let $f, g : \alpha \to \mathbb{R}$ satisfy $f(a) \le g(a)$ for every $a \in \alpha$. Then the expectation of $f$ under $p$ is at most the expectation of $g$ under $p$.
nodes.title: Monotonicity of expectation

nodes.summary: Let $p$ be a probability mass function on a finite measurable space $\alpha$ in which singletons are measurable, let $\beta$ be a measurable space in which singletons are measurable, and let $g : \alpha \to \beta$ and $f : \beta \to \mathbb{R}$. Write $g_* p$ for the pushforward of $p$ along $g$, which gives each $b \in \beta$ the mass $\sum_{a :\, g(a) = b} p(a)$. Then the expectation of $f$ under $g_* p$ equals…
nodes.title: Change of variables for expectation

nodes.summary: Let $p$ be a probability mass function on a finite measurable space $\alpha$ in which singletons are measurable, and let $f : \alpha \to \mathbb{R}$ satisfy $f(a) \ge 0$ for every $a \in \alpha$. Then the expectation of $f$ under $p$ is nonnegative.
nodes.title: Nonnegativity of expectation

nodes.summary: Let $p$ be a probability mass function on a finite measurable space $\alpha$ in which singletons are measurable, let $c \in \mathbb{R}$ and let $f : \alpha \to \mathbb{R}$. The expectation under $p$ of the scalar multiple $c f$ (the function $a \mapsto c \cdot f(a)$) equals $c$ times the expectation of $f$ under $p$.
nodes.title: Expectation of a scalar multiple

nodes.summary: Let $p$ be a probability mass function on a finite type $\alpha$ carrying a σ-algebra in which singletons are measurable, and write $\mathbb{E}_p[g]$ for the expectation of $g : \alpha \to \mathbb{R}$ under $p$. For every finite subset $s$ of an index type $\iota$ and every family of functions $f_i : \alpha \to \mathbb{R}$, $i \in \iota$, we have…
nodes.title: Expectation of a finite sum

nodes.summary: Let $\alpha$ be a nonempty finite type carrying a σ-algebra in which singletons are measurable. For every function $f : \alpha \to \mathbb{R}$, the expectation of $f$ under the uniform distribution on $\alpha$ equals the average $\frac{1}{|\alpha|} \sum_{a \in \alpha} f(a)$.
nodes.title: Expectation under the uniform distribution

nodes.summary: Let $\alpha$ be a type carrying a σ-algebra in which singletons are measurable, let $p$ be a probability mass function on $\alpha$ and let $f : \alpha \to \mathbb{R}$. The expectation of $f$ under $p$ is the Bochner integral $\int f \, d\mu_p$, where $\mu_p$ is the probability measure on $\alpha$ associated to $p$.
nodes.title: Expectation under a probability mass function

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
